title: Tableau Subscription and Alert Delivery Failures
dataSources: Tableau Server logs (`tableau:backgrounder`, `tableau:vizqlserver`, `tableau:httpd`), `workgroup` repository tables (`background_jobs`, `http_requests`, `_views_stats`, `licensing`) via DB Connect, Tableau Cloud Admin Insights / Activity Log exports.
app: Splunk DB Connect (Splunkbase 2686) against the Tableau Server `workgroup` PostgreSQL repository; Tableau Server logs via Universal Forwarder; Tableau Server REST API and TSM metrics via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:backgrounder (job_type=single_subscription_notify OR job_type=data_alerts)
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(finish_code!=0)) as failures by job_type, subscription_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks scheduled subscription emails and data-driven alerts and surfaces those failing to deliver, which otherwise fail silently and erode trust in Tableau notifications.
value: Executives relying on a morning subscription email never know when it silently fails; catching delivery failures keeps stakeholders informed and preserves confidence in the platform.
implementation: Ingest Backgrounder logs; schedule hourly; alert on repeated failures for the same subscription. Verify SMTP configuration when delivery failures spike.
visualization: Table of failing subscriptions, timechart of delivery failures.
grandmaExplanation: We check that the scheduled report emails and alerts from Tableau actually go out, so people are not left waiting for a message that never arrived.
